title: Add TASKS.json Export Endpoint to SpecForge API
description: Implement a new route `POST /api/epics/:id/export-tasks` in `apps/api` that converts extracted user stories and acceptance criteria directly into a valid `TASKS.json` backlog format for autonomous agents to consume.
acceptance_criteria: Route maps user stories to TASK objects with id, title, description, and acceptance_criteria
Validates export output against TASKS.json schema

title: Add Vitest Unit Test Suite for Requirements Extractor with Mock Fixtures
description: Add Vitest test suite in `apps/api/test/extractor.test.ts` mocking Claude tool responses with JSON fixture files to verify parsing of malformed inputs, multi-page specs, and edge-case stories offline.
acceptance_criteria: Tests run offline in <3 seconds without live Anthropic API keys
Covers epic extraction, user story parsing, and Zod validation

title: Remove minio.exe Binary from Git Tracking
description: Untrack `.tools/minio.exe` (107.9MB) from git history and add `.tools/*.exe` to `.gitignore` to prevent large binary bloat.
acceptance_criteria: minio.exe is removed from git tracking
Docker compose MinIO service remains unaffected
